name: check-characteristics-threshold-offroster-fixture
_why: Planted for @SCN-CHR-002's @integration arm — THE MINT ON THE MEASURED SIDE. `flakiness` is not a word fitness-functions.md carries, and a measured check has no runnable script handle, so `specController.checkRegistry` can never hold it: the only place it is ever named is here. This target's registry is DELIBERATELY all roster words, so a check reading the registry alone admits this tree and the red can only have come from the thresholds — which is the half of the config the fault survived in. `SCN-TGT-002`'s `ci-run-time` beside it is a roster word and must be left alone.
